messages:
Ava: Quick idea  run a 30-person Design Partner pilot but recruit by mindset rather than company size: product-builders, infra/ops, and cost-focused. want to see different success signals.
Diego: Nice. I'll draft a 3-question screener to tag mindset. keep it 30s. suggest target 10 per group.
Maya: For incentives propose testing two variants: 4 hours premium support vs $400 credit. track which yields more active feedback.
Jordan: Onboarding differences: infra cohort gets a runbook + optional 1:1; product cohort gets prompt templates and eval recipes; cost cohort gets Optimize walkthrough.
Priya: Need a short consent checkbox referencing anonymized telemetry and incentive terms. I'll draft language.
Ava: Draft success signals briefly: product = first integration + 1 feedback session in 14 days; infra = perf baseline + infra notes from 30%+; cost = adoption of cost suggestions for 50%+.
Diego: Measurement: funnel events (invite->accept->onboard), #feedback sessions, nps_30, qualitative tags. I'll output a tiny CSV schema for analytics.
Maya: Recruitment copy test: "Ship features faster" vs "Lower inference costs". A/B the subject line.
Jordan: Onboard checklist to automate: issue API key + sample call, auto perf test (10 requests) upload results, join slack, schedule 1:1. can build a small script to run #2.
Sam: Ops can support but suggest staggered waves (10/week) to avoid 1:1 overload.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: add cohort to dp-beta-queue and auto-tag segment when screener passes.
Ava: Next steps: Diego = screener + schema; Maya = invite variants; Priya = consent; Jordan = perf-test automation; Sam = schedule waves. I'll compile rollout calendar and open outreach next Tuesday.
